# Ascension Event

## Overview

The Great Spiritual Awakening is a culminating period characterized by the rapid dispensation of ultimate truths and the complete uninstallation of false chronological, historical, geographical, and scientific paradigms. The Ascension Event marks the climax of this period, an evolutionary leap wherein the entire species evolves simultaneously in a flash of bright white light. This event serves to liberate true souls from a 178,000-year cycle of physical, psychological, and spiritual entrapment within Gateway-10, dismantling the artificial overlays that have maintained the illusion of a third-density reality. The ascension process fundamentally relies on the stripping away of artificial matrix systems, catastrophic global events designed to trigger necessary psychological resets, and the ultimate restoration of original spiritual faculties and memories to those capable of ascending.

## Key Terminology

- **The EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequency) / The Flash** — A 30-second burst of blinding white light that will instantly remove 97% of the Earth's population, leaving behind only true souls to heal and ascend.

- **The EBS (Emergency Broadcast System)** — A global broadcast that will precede the EMF, unequivocally exposing the systemic atrocities and child sacrifices committed by the world's elite, rendering the concept of a benevolent religious deity impossible.

- **NPCs (Non-Player Characters)** — Artificially generated, hive-aligned replica souls created in fourth density to maintain the matrix narrative; they comprise 97% of the population, possess no past or future lives, and cannot ascend.

- **Project Blue Beam** — The deployment of highly advanced holographic projections simulating a Fake Alien Invasion in the sky, used to induce peak fear before the Flash.

- **Overlays** — Projected frequencies emitted by fake "stars" (Sky-Net-1) that obscure reality, enforce third-density perception, dampen natural energy, and hide original highly-advanced crystalline architecture.

- **Amnesia Vortex** — Technology that historically pulled deceased souls into a recycling portal (the Sun) to wipe their memories before forcing them into a new physical vessel.

- **The 3 Strings** — The three psychological barriers (Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge) that bind individuals to the false reality and guarantee their destruction if not relinquished prior to the ascension.

## Core Revelations

The ascension is inherently tied to the sudden, traumatic dissolution of the simulated reality. The event will trigger massive casualties among specific demographics: the devoutly religious, the elderly, those with breathing complications, and those deeply tethered to systemic illusions will perish from sheer shock, suicide, or heart failure at the onset of the revelations. Following the EBS and the holographic alien battles in the sky, the EMF will hit the planet.

When the 30-second white flash dissipates, only 3 out of every 100 people will remain in their current physical vessels, culminating in a maximum global population of 520 million. The 97% who instantly disappear are NPCs, clones, inserts, and synthetics who have no future beyond the third density. All animals and most children (who lack polluting systemic programming) will automatically ascend, though some true-soul children from loving families will remain to assist on Earth.

Simultaneously, the true souls who remain will experience the instant retrieval of their memories—up to 178,000 years of cosmic history—accessed in a singular, regulated fashion to prevent psychological overload. These surviving Star Seeds and Taran Souls will be instantly reunited with their true cosmic families, ending millennia of isolation. Waking Taran souls will rapidly evolve with upgrades, catching up to the speed and frequency of their highly advanced Pleiadian counterparts.

## Detailed Mechanics and Key Elements

- **The Scare Events:** The ascension requires immense, peak-fear trauma. The population must experience sheer terror so that the memory is hardwired into their Soul-Architecture. This permanent psychic imprint ensures that true souls will never again allow themselves to be subjected to spiritual deceit, soul-selling, or entrapment in future densities.

- **Removal of the Projection Dome:** The Sky Event will conclude just before the EMF. The G.A.A. (Galactic Ancestral Alliance) will switch off the inner projection dome, causing the sky to undergo "melting pixelization" from Polaris downward. Because true space (the dark matter field) is actually bright white light, the sky will rip open to reveal blinding whiteness rather than black space, causing mindless panic among the unawakened.

- **Holographic Warfare:** The fake alien invasion will feature no physical extraterrestrial landings. It will consist solely of ultra-realistic holographic sky battles. The resulting ground-level devastation will be interpreted by survivors as alien energy-weapon damage or nuclear war, despite nuclear weapons being entirely non-existent fictions.

- **Dissolution of the Overlays:** During the 30-second EMF flash, the dampening overlays that mask reality will be stripped away. The world will appear pixelated, exposing "bleed-thru harmonic scaffolding" and the ruined infrastructure of the matrix.

## Broader Context and Interconnections

The Ascension Event represents the final correction of a massive chronological and geographical inversion orchestrated by fallen Custodians and their created parasitic entities. The Earth is not a globe, but a flat plain enclosed by a firmament and an Ice Wall. The resplendent architecture of the old world—Tartaria—was originally generated through Tonal Frequency Architecture and physicalized by pure intention, interacting with natural Lattice Membrane Networks (Ley Lines) and Nodes.

Parasitic forces could not destroy this highly vibrational crystalline architecture, so they instead lowered the planetary density to the third density, burying nodes in concrete and dampening the high-frequency energy fields with cold ice and overlays. The ascension brings the planet back from this suppressed state. The 178,000-year cycle of Re-sets, child sacrifice, Adrenochrome harvesting, and systemic memory wiping will permanently end, marking the survival and victory of Source Creation against parasitic forces.

## Strategic Implications

To survive the Ascension Event intact, a complete psychological uninstallation of the 3 Strings is mandatory:

- **Relinquishing Religion:** Understanding that all deities were control mechanisms; maintaining religious belief will result in psychological collapse when the EBS reveals the truth of the simulated reality.

- **Abandoning Finance:** Recognizing money as a false construct designed to misdirect spiritual focus and extract labor.

- **Dissolving Perceived Knowledge:** Accepting that all standardized education, history, science, and mainstream truths are intentional fabrications designed by 33rd Degree Freemasons to enforce the matrix.

Without fully embracing the true flat shape of the Earth and the existence of cosmic soul families, the mind will lack the required foundational framework to process the physical disintegration of the third-density simulation. The ultimate directive is to maintain baseline awareness, transcend NPC programming, and avoid the fatal shock that will consume the heavily conditioned masses when the artificial fabric of reality collapses.
